MANUAL TAANSAXLE {C56) - MANUAL TAANSAXLE ASSEMHL Y
REASSEMBLY
\ ._< Reassembly is in the reverse order of disassembly. (See page MX-12}
NOTJCE:
When working with FIPG material, you must observe the followlngs.
Using a razor blade and gasket scraper, remove all old FIPG material from the gasket surfaces.
Thoroughly clean all components to remove all loose material.
Clean both sealing surfaces with a non-residue solvent.
• Apply FIPG in an approx. 1 mm (0.04 in.} wide bead along the sealing surface.
Parts must be assembled within 10 minutes of application. Otherwise, the FIPG material must
be removed and reapplied.
HINT:
Coat all of the sliding and rotating surfaces with gear oil before reassembly_
